_README: Your offer catalog. One entry per product you're considering or promoting. The numbers come from the ClickBank Marketplace listing or the Digistore24 Marketplace card — copy them in, then run offer_scorer.py to rank them. The three entries below are SCHEMA EXAMPLES with placeholder vendor IDs: replace them with real offers you pulled from the marketplace today. Never promote an offer you haven't checked yourself — marketplace stats move weekly.

_FIELD_GUIDE.vendor: ClickBank ONLY — the vendor's nickname (the bit in the hoplink)
_FIELD_GUIDE.product_id: Digistore24 ONLY — the numeric product ID
_FIELD_GUIDE.name: Human name, used in reports
_FIELD_GUIDE.niche: health | wealth | relationships | survival | spirituality | software | hobby
_FIELD_GUIDE.avg_commission_usd: ClickBank: Avg $/conversion. Digistore24: earnings per sale.
_FIELD_GUIDE.gravity: ClickBank Gravity score (skip for Digistore24, use 0)
_FIELD_GUIDE.ds24_rating: Digistore24 marketplace rating 0-100 (skip for ClickBank, use 0)
_FIELD_GUIDE.earnings_per_click_usd: EPC / 'Avg $/hop' if the marketplace shows it, else 0
_FIELD_GUIDE.refund_rate_pct: Stated refund/cancellation rate if shown, else your estimate (health supplements often 8-15)
_FIELD_GUIDE.avg_rebill_total_usd: ClickBank 'Avg Rebill Total' — lifetime rebill value, 0 if none
_FIELD_GUIDE.has_upsells: true if there's a funnel behind the front end
_FIELD_GUIDE.affiliate_page: URL of the vendor's affiliate/JV page (where swipe copy lives)
_FIELD_GUIDE.vsl_or_text: vsl | text | both — how the sales page sells
_FIELD_GUIDE.mobile_checkout_ok: true if you opened the sales page ON YOUR PHONE and checkout worked
_FIELD_GUIDE.audience_fit: 1-10 — how well this matches the audience you can actually reach
_FIELD_GUIDE.bridge_slug: folder name of its bridge page, e.g. nerve — leave blank for none
_FIELD_GUIDE.notes: Anything you learned while vetting it
